body:
**Orchestrator decision: DM-45 attempt 1 rejected so the s2 gap gets closed within this sprint.**

DM-45's end-to-end run found that epic success criterion s2 is only partly met. The ticket view and attempt cards show both size and effort, but graph nodes show only the size (`src/renderer/src/graph/nodes.tsx`). This gap dates from sprint 1, and the sprint 1 acceptance round did not catch it.

This is the epic's last sprint, and the installed server cannot redraft a new sprint. Reporting s2 as unmet would leave the epic-outcome gate unmet, so I am fixing it in the acceptance round, the same way DM-44 fixed its Definition of Done findings. Attempt 2 will:
- add effort to the graph card, tests first;
- re-run the Definition of Done checks the fix affects, and grade the new tests with Fireguard;
- amend the single sprint 3 squash on `scrum-cadence`.

Attempt 2 stays on the same model, because the rejection is a plan gap, not a capability failure.

**Records correction:** DM-38 and DM-39 ran on Sonnet, not Opus. My dispatch brief said Opus; the attempt records are correct.
